twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the six-digit code your authenticator app shows for DBS manager.
twoFactor.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each one works once.
twoFactor.codeHint: Six digits; a new one appears every 30 seconds.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
enroll.subtitle: Every sign-in asks for your password and a code from an authenticator app. Set it up once, now.
enroll.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
enroll.qrLabel: A QR code that adds DBS manager to your authenticator app
enroll.typeInstead: Or type this key into the app by hand.
enroll.confirm: Enter the code the app now shows, to confirm it works.

recovery.title: Your recovery codes
recovery.subtitle: Two-factor sign-in is on. If you lose your authenticator app, each of these codes lets you sign in once.
recovery.keep: This is the only time they are shown. Keep them somewhere safe, away from this computer.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.required: Your password expires on {date}, or the master account asked for a new one. Choose a new password to continue.
changePassword.newHint: Different from the current one, at least 8 characters, not only numbers.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.

errors.unavailable: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: Your role, your password and the codes that get you in without your authenticator app.
account.passwordBody: The password lasts 30 days. Changing it starts the 30 days again.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.body: Making new codes replaces every code you have now.
recovery.promptBody: Enter your password. The codes you have now stop working.

errors.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the page may have moved.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
errors.forbiddenBody: Ask an administrator if you think you should.
errors.name_taken: This name is already in use.
errors.absolute_path_required: Use a full path that starts with / and has no .. in it.
errors.network: Can't reach DBS. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_code: The code is not right, or it was already used.
errors.sign_in_expired: The sign-in took too long. Sign in again.
errors.two_factor_enrolled: This account already has two-factor sign-in.
errors.two_factor_missing: This account has no two-factor sign-in yet.
errors.password_change_required: Your password has expired. Choose a new one to continue.
errors.password_unchanged: Choose a password you have not been using.
errors.password_entirely_numeric: Use letters as well as numbers.
errors.password_too_similar: The password is too close to the username.
errors.authentication_failed: The username or password is not correct.
errors.host_key_changed: The server presented a different host key.
errors.ssh_auth_failed: The server refused the username, key or password.
errors.ssh_unreachable: The server did not answer over SSH.
errors.stream_broken: The connection broke while the backup was arriving. The server keeps it, and the manager collects it at the next connection.
errors.remote_command_failed: A command on the server failed.
errors.remote_command_timed_out: A command on the server ran out of time and was stopped.
errors.connection_lost: The connection to the server was lost while it worked.
errors.invalid_host_key: The host key is not valid. Get it again.
errors.backup_invalid: The backup file is not valid.
errors.backup_quarantined: The backup failed verification when it arrived, so it is kept aside and never restored.
errors.backup_running: A backup or restore of this server is already running.
errors.server_settling: A command that ran out of time may still be stopping on this server. Try again in a minute.
errors.interrupted: The job stopped before it finished.
errors.unexpected: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again.
errors.backup_missing: This backup's file is no longer here.
errors.archive_mismatch: The archive fetched here does not match the one on the server. Nothing was kept.
errors.archive_failed: The archive could not be created on the server.
errors.restore_failed: The restore failed on the server.
errors.dbs_too_old: django-dbs on the server is too old for this. Upgrade it to the version this manager runs.
errors.remote_not_found: The folder or file does not exist on the server.
errors.remote_permission_denied: Access to the folder or file was denied on the server.
errors.env_path_missing: This server has no .env file set.
errors.upload_too_large: The file is too large to upload.
errors.file_exists: A file or folder with this name already exists here.
errors.folder_not_empty: The folder is not empty. Only an empty folder can be deleted.
errors.cannot_delete_root: An allowed folder cannot be deleted.
errors.path_outside_roots: This path is outside the server's allowed folders.
errors.no_allowed_folders: This server has no allowed folders.
errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.role_required: Your account's role does not allow this. Ask the master account.
errors.master_protected: The master account cannot be demoted or disabled. Hand the master role to another account first.
errors.own_account: You cannot change your own account this way.
errors.account_inactive: That account is disabled. Enable it first.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

copy.unavailable: Copying is not available here. Select the text and copy it.
